snippet.title: OUTER WILDS: Astral Codec | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
A mod for Outer Wilds exploring the origin of The Interloper.

Download here:
https://outerwildsmods.com/mods/astralcodec/

Developed by Walker
Trailer by Texture_Turtle
Music by Greenpixel, JohnCorby, and Reavo End
Additional Assets by Texture_Turtle, Greenpixel, JohnCorby, and Reavo End
Playtesting by JohnCorby, Book, MegaPiggy, Caffeinated Gay, FunkyShoeMan, Schpungus, xen 12, Samster68, Toby Wright, Quantum Luna, pikpik, and GameWyrm
Special Thanks to the Outer Wilds Modding Discord Server
